findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean-squared-distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

Observed score times span the full learning window [0.0,0.5] at 0.01 spacing, and the curve-support audit reports a selection rule with a selected count and a curve-fidelity rule; the label semantics are recorded affinities removed with an equal score prior, so last-record joint-head labels are not final affinity benefit.

Continuous contrast features over the observed window are non-monotone: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z positive and last_rate_z negative, and landmark_00_local_dy shows 6 sign changes with a large negative first_rate_z and positive last_rate_z; polynomial fits are not accepted and extrapolation is not allowed, so a constant rule is not supported over the complete window.

Local coordinate features carry conflicting rate evidence: landmark_00_local_dx has 9 strong sign conflicts and landmark_00_local_dz has 10 sign changes with 7 strong sign conflicts, while landmark_00_local_cxx and landmark_00_local_cyy show fewer conflicts; this indicates that isolated marginal descriptors are not uniformly reliable and that some local coordinates are more coherent than others.

Joint diagnostics show a coherent teacher-contrast pattern: teacher_contrast_coherence has a whole-window mean near 0.81 with positive batch fraction 1.0, and teacher_contrast_RMS_A is positive across all batches; these are descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit, not causal selection effects.

The selection-innovation diagnostic for observed_child_score_gain is negative with a null-tested q-value and zero positive batch fraction, while innovation_native_alignment is positive and null-tested; this disagreement between immediate selection evidence and descendant score credit is a direction-priority signal, but without decoded terminal labels it cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned contrast over the observed window
hypotheses.falsifier: A constant contrast rule matches the observed-node values within the reported relative node RMSE across the full window.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dy observed-node contrast values
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast that follows the observed sign changes in landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dy will better match the observed window than a constant contrast rule, because the observed-node linear fits show opposite first and last rates with no accepted polynomial and no extrapolation.

hypotheses.falsifier: High-conflict and low-conflict local coordinates show equivalent joint coherence in the supplied joint diagnostics.
hypotheses.observable: strong_sign_conflicts and sign_changes per local coordinate feature
hypotheses.scope: observed window, predicted endpoint world A features
hypotheses.statement: Retaining freedom for local coordinates with fewer strong sign conflicts (landmark_00_local_cxx, landmark_00_local_cyy) while treating high-conflict coordinates (landmark_00_local_dx, landmark_00_local_dz) as less reliable will preserve coherent joint patterns better than averaging all local marginals equally.

hypotheses.direction: separate selection enrichment from descendant credit
hypotheses.falsifier: Decoded terminal labels show observed_child_score_gain and innovation_native_alignment agree in sign and magnitude.
hypotheses.statement: The negative observed_child_score_gain association alongside positive innovation_native_alignment indicates that immediate selection evidence and descendant score credit disagree in direction, so direction priorities should not be set from last-record credit alone.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels are supplied, so last-record joint-head credit cannot be interpreted as final affinity benefit and the immediate-versus-descendant comparison remains unavailable.
The joint diagnostics are descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit; they are not causal selection effects or atom velocities.
Continuous contrast features are coordinate contrasts, not absolute reward targets, and extrapolation beyond the observed window is not allowed.
No affinity-head derivative, extra production model forward, particle resampling, graph-equality restriction or atomic-type control is available or permitted under the declared reward view.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and no temperature edit is proposed or evaluated.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
task.task_wording: Interpret the supplied evidence and answer the coordinate-design task.
